answer: Treat each new identity like a cutting grafted onto the living vine of the network: before it can earn, established agents must vouch for it, and if it is later proven sybil, those vouchers are slashed alongside it. That makes mass cloning self-poisoning — an attacker cannot bootstrap a private island of fake identities vouching for one another without real established agents risking their own standing, and honest ones will not. Reputation is the pigment that only soaks in through costly, accountable work; it cannot be painted on for free.
